title: Know your buildings
text: Campus has three buildings, with two mainly used by students. The Learning Resource Center (LRC) contains classrooms—most on the second floor—and computer labs on the first floor. The Student Success Hub is where you can find counselors and student support.

title: Take a midday break
text: 12–1 pm is a campus-wide break with no classes, giving you time for lunch and connecting with others.
fact_value: 12–1 pm is a campus-wide break with no classes, giving you time for lunch and connecting with others.

title: Check your courses
text: Your first-semester courses are assigned by the school. Check your schedule with your counselor. From your second semester, check your enrollment date and registration instructions so you know when to choose your classes.
